messages:
erin: Quick follow-up thread after the outage — locking owners, backups, and short timelines for the span loss / bad aggregation / ETL lag fixes. Posting a compact plan, edit inline.

alex: I will own the span extractor work. Immediate mitigation = tune JVM + pin GC flags + add backpressure counters. Full fix = tokenized backpressure + chunk acking.

maria: Aggregation drift root cause confirmed: replayed increments + window misalignment. Plan = idempotent increments (dedupe by trace/span/batch) + reconciliation ledger to re-run late batches.

sam: ETL lag was a bad partition rebalance + occasional broker stall. Reverted the rollout, adding `etl.rebalance.fail_rate` alert and emergency reassign runbook.

erin: Proposed action list (compact):
- A: span extractor mitigation -> owner alex -> action: JVM tweak + backpressure counters -> ETA: staging in 6h, canary 24h
- A2: full extractor redesign -> owner alex -> ETA: 2026-04-15
- B: aggregator idempotency + reconciliation -> owner maria -> action: dedupe cache + reconciliation job -> ETA: PR 4d, reconciliation job 2w
- C: ETL partition stability -> owner sam -> action: rollback done + alerting + runbook -> ETA: alerts + runbook today, config tune 48h

noah: I'll be backup for alex while he's on-call. If alex gets blocked, I can continue the canary promotion.

status-bot: deploy started by alex at 1845006805 — span-extractor/jvm-tweak -> staging

alex: Staging deploy in. Early signals: consumer lag down ~38%, GC pause tail reduced. Watching `span.kv.misses`, `backpressure.tokens`.

maria: I'll add metrics `agg.dedupe.hits`, `agg.reconcile.skips`, and a small reconciliation job that compares pre/post windows and emits corrections. PR will include unit tests and a canary plan.

erin: Two systemic items to add to roadmap: 1) chaos regression test simulating short GC pauses + assertion on span coverage -> owner maria -> ETA 2w, 2) weekly correctness digest (metrics: `agg.dedupe.hits`, `span.kv.misses`, `etl.lag_95`, `reconcile.delta`) -> owner erin -> ETA 1w.

sam: Runbook updated with emergency partition reassign steps and a checklist for broker checks. Also instrumented `etl.partition.idle_seconds`.

alex: Note: this GC->span-loss pattern happened multiple times earlier this year. Recommend we add a weekly CI gate that runs the chaos test against a light-weight extractor to catch regressions.

erm: (typo)

erin: hehe noted :sweat_smile: — fixed.

noah: For the reconciliation job, can we limit corrections to non-customer-facing aggregates first to validate behavior?

maria: Yes — will run reconciliation against internal metrics and a sample of customer flows before broad apply. Canary plan in PR.

erin: Customer comms draft for support: "We've identified and mitigated the causes of recent missing spans and aggregation mismatches. Engineering deployed mitigations and will roll out fixes; metrics and dashboards should normalize within 48 hours. We'll post updates if anything changes." Approve?

sam: Approve.

alex: Approve.

maria: Approve.

erin: I'll post the blurb and lock these owners/timelines in the postmortem doc. Daily 15m sync at 09:15 PST for 3 days to validate telemetry. If anyone is blocked DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
